sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for sharing the cost background and for your continued support; we understand that your focus is on customers with larger volumes and appreciate the long-standing relationship. Our volume is fixed for the term and covers our full demand for this part, and the longer contract term offers planning security as our forecast demand is rising. We understand that management has frozen price reductions, so could we explore whether any of the other terms might be adjusted?

Your quote of 2026-09-06 for this part was EUR 4.39 per unit ("List conditions; supply from stock only") (quote:7300004).
We currently buy this part from another supplier at EUR 4.20 (po:4500014447-10, po:4500014370-10).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
The price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms at a unit price of €4.94.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our internal cost structures are strictly confidential.
Could you please provide concrete data to support your volume forecast?
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
